basis: The state incidence map uses a color gradient from pale yellow (High, 100) to dark burgundy (Low, 0) to encode incidence levels. West Virginia (WV) and Utah (UT) are both shaded in the darkest burgundy, indicating the lowest incidence level (near 0). Alabama (AL) is shaded orange, indicating a moderate incidence level (between 40 and 60). Since the task requires routing to the highest-incidence state among the eligible options, and WV and UT are at the lowest end, AL is the only state among the three options with a higher incidence value.
option_label: Open Alabama (AL) incidence detail for priority follow-up
